$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): the registry entry of one version of a Floorspec extension, at registry/<name>/extension.json (Floorspec Core 12.2). Defaults are those of 12.2's tables.
title: Floorspec extension registry entry
description: Core 12.2: name, version, lifecycle status, schema, dependencies, the kinds of element and the taxonomy terms one version of an extension adds. A validator's known extensions are a set of these (FS-CORE-12.2.1); that no two share a name and version, and that `requires` forms no cycle, are checked by the validator (FS-CFG-001).

version.title: Version
version.description: 12.2: the version this entry describes: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, <major>.<minor>.<patch> with an optional -prerelease, without build metadata.

status.title: Status
status.description: 12.2: where the extension is in its lifecycle (registry/README.md).

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: 12.2: where the extension's JSON Schema for this version is published: an absolute https URI.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: 12.3: the extensions this one depends on, each with a version range.

additionalProperties.title: Version range
additionalProperties.description: 12.3: comparators (>=, >, <=, <, =, ^, ~, or none) on full versions, separated by spaces within a set, with sets separated by ||.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: 12.2, 12.5: the kinds of element the extension adds, each named by the collection that holds its elements.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: 12.2, 4.2: the taxonomy terms the extension adds, without the extension-name prefix.

implementations.title: Implementations
implementations.description: 12.2: software that implements this version; a ratified extension lists at least two independent implementations (FLR-ADR-007).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 12.2: one kind of element the extension adds.

fallback.description: 12.2, 12.4.2: which optional parts of a fallback every element of the kind carries.

asset.description: Every element carries a glTF asset.
